audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player his level-6 dive goes through Steadfast Presence: 'your R leap still lands' and 'dives her cleanly even through Steadfast Presence's dash-block since it lands on her'. Stormbringer is the ONLY dash-flagged ability in Volibear's kit, and Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes around her, slowing and grounding what it catches.
audit.why: This is the single worst kind of error on the page: it actively instructs the player to throw a 160-second ultimate into the one ability built to eat it. The mirror found the same claim inverted on the Poppy side (it had Steadfast Presence grounding Thundering Smash, which is not a dash at all).
audit.corrected: Steadfast Presence: 20/18/16/14/12s, gains move speed, stops enemy dashes near her, and slows and grounds anything it stops. Hold Stormbringer until she spends it. Also newly stated: Keeper's Verdict is a CHANNEL, so Thundering Smash's stun cancels it outright. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s and only stuns if you are pushed into terrain.
sources: brief enemyKit W/E/R Riot text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W Frenzied Maul shred' appears in four places. W applies on-hit effects and marks the target; the SECOND cast into the mark deals bonus damage and heals.
audit.why: The heal on the re-cast is what wins every extended trade in this matchup, and calling it 'shred' hides it.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul: 5s, 325 range, marks and applies on-hit; re-cast into the mark for bonus damage and the heal.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer lets you dive and burst Poppy before her tankiness matters. Note her W Steadfast Presence blocks dashes, but your R leap still lands — engage with R and Q and you win the all-in cleanly.
edits.after: Stormbringer dives her and disables the tower where you land, but Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes around her and grounds what it catches — hold the leap until she has spent it, 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 3 through first item are yours. Your Q stun plus W shred out-DPS Poppy's kit, and at 6 your R leap dives her cleanly even through Steadfast Presence's dash-block since it lands on her. The one rule is positioning: fight in open lane so her E Heroic Charge can't stun you into terrain, and punish every E cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 3 through first item are yours. Thundering Smash's stun into both Frenzied Maul bites out-damages her kit and the re-cast heal wins long trades. At 6, do not open with Stormbringer while Steadfast Presence is up — it stops dashes around her. Fight in open lane so Heroic Charge has no wall to pin you against, and punish every 12s E cooldown.

edits.before: Poppy scales into a durable anti-carry tank. Steadfast Presence blocks your R dash and grounds you, Heroic Charge and Keeper's Verdict cancel your engages, and her bulk means your DPS can't finish her — she out-utilities you in extended fights.
edits.after: Poppy scales into a durable anti-carry tank. Steadfast Presence stops your Stormbringer and grounds you, and Heroic Charge peels you off. Keeper's Verdict is a channel, though — Thundering Smash's stun cancels it outright, and that is your cleanest answer late.

edits.before: With two-plus items Poppy flips ahead. As a full tank she becomes an anti-engage nightmare — Steadfast Presence blocks your R dash and grounds you, Heroic Charge peels you off, and Keeper's Verdict can knock you out of a commit. Her bulk shrugs off your DPS, so you need the lead won before her tank scaling arrives.
edits.after: With two-plus items Poppy becomes an anti-engage problem rather than a killer: Steadfast Presence stops your Stormbringer and grounds you, Heroic Charge peels, and Keeper's Verdict knocks you out of a commit — but it is a channel, so your stun cancels it. Her bulk shrugs off your DPS, so bank the lead early.

edits.before: You out-trade Poppy through the early levels. Your Q Thundering Smash stun and W Frenzied Maul shred beat her Q Hammer Shock poke, and you deal sustained damage she can't match. Just be aware her E Heroic Charge wants a wall — fight in open lane so she can't stun you into terrain.
edits.after: You out-trade Poppy through the early levels: Thundering Smash's stun into both Frenzied Maul bites beats her Hammer Shock poke, and the re-cast heal carries the long trade. Her Heroic Charge wants a wall — fight in open lane and all it does is push you, with no stun.
